bio: The restaurant is located in the modern Hotel Perk – the name of which is a reference to the town of Šumperk. The trendy urban interior is inviting. Make a beeline for one of the tables to the rear or, for a livelier experience, those directly opposite the open kitchen offer views of the chefs at work. The dishes are seasonal and are prepared with modern creativity and precision. Tip: Book an overnight stay in one of the hotel's comfortable modern guestrooms....
